rules: bind the exact selected Joshua source member and the shared CCEL catalogue
verify the title profile digest, all nineteen nonoverlapping groups, and the exact forty-five-member partition
represent exactly the selected complete title body while retaining the catalogue as shared front matter
preserve original CCEL sibling hrefs as external links and account for all excluded sibling components by title group
independently compare source selectors, TEI element mappings, ordered text streams, and source-member wrapper identity
validate the title-scoped accountability record and TEI P5
technical validation does not establish acceptance, rights clearance, canonical admission, or publication

unresolved.detail: Human review must assess the retained component's edition and witness lineage against the catalogue and metadata evidence.
Component translator credits and source spelling variants remain source-bound evidence pending metadata review.
Source-reported Public Domain statements require human rights review before publication.
Source-to-TEI mapping preserves the component's selectors and text; editorial meaning of all ThML presentation conventions remains open.
The bounded inherited seven-pane review does not establish exhaustive visual collation of all Joshua content.
Technical validation and visual inspection are not human textual acceptance.
This candidate is not publication-ready or publication-authorized.
